data.text: At The VIDYA School, athletic training, physical vitality, and teamwork are fundamental pillars of holistic human development.

items.title: Outdoor Sports Complex
items.description: Cricket training pitches, full-size football turf, regulation basketball court, volleyball arena, and running tracks.

items.title: Indoor Games & Fitness
items.description: Badminton courts, table tennis arenas, chess and carrom halls, and gymnastics practice facilities.

items.title: Daily Yoga & Wellness
items.description: Morning pranayama, yogic asanas, mental mindfulness conditioning, and annual sports championship meets.
